authorityReview.evidence: The inspected inherited Solmate ERC4626 deposit previews shares and rejects a zero-share result, transfers the vault’s fixed immutable ERC-20 asset from msg.sender, mints to the caller-selected receiver, and invokes AutoPxEth.afterDeposit to update staked accounting. The ordinary path does not wrap native ETH. Protocol token behavior, zero-share rounding, and asset allowance/balance may reject execution. No platform amount/receiver/feed rule or automatic approval/grant is added. The dated official product role and address-bound source/ABI do not establish current runtime/constructor asset configuration, asset value, funding, liquidity, execution success, or financial safety.

The inspected inherited Solmate ERC4626 mint previews the required assets, transfers the vault’s fixed immutable ERC-20 asset from msg.sender, mints the caller-selected shares to receiver, and invokes AutoPxEth.afterDeposit to update staked accounting. The ordinary path does not wrap native ETH. Protocol conversion, token behavior, and asset allowance/balance may reject execution. No platform financial/receiver rule or automatic approval/grant is added. The dated official product role and address-bound source/ABI do not establish current runtime/constructor asset configuration, asset value, funding, liquidity, execution success, or financial safety.

The inherited ERC4626 path previews required shares (including AutoPxEth withdrawal penalty behavior), checks/spends existing owner-to-caller share allowance when needed, calls beforeWithdraw, burns owner shares, and transfers the fixed ERC-20 asset to caller-selected receiver. AutoPxEth beforeWithdraw may harvest if the requested assets exceed totalStaked; harvest pays the configured platform address from the fixed asset, then the path updates accounting. Owner/receiver/amount remain caller-selected; protocol balances, allowance, rounding, fee/reward state, and liquidity may revert. No platform equality/cap/feed gate or automatic approval is added. The dated official product role and address-bound source/ABI do not establish current runtime/constructor asset configuration, asset value, funding, liquidity, execution success, or financial safety.
